text: She unseals her helmet - PULLS IT OFF ... INT. HANGAR, COOPER STATION - NIGHT Cooper and Tars scurry down the line of sleek ships. Cooper points - Tars starts working the hatch mechanism, while Cooper KEEPS WATCH ... EXT. EDMUNDS’ DESERT PLANET - DAY Brand, helmet off, BREATHES. And breathes again. MURPH (V.O.) Maybe, right now, she’s settling in for the long nap ... 156. INT. RANGER IN HANGAR, COOPER STATION - NIGHT Cooper STRAPS into the pilot’s chair, Tars beside him. The outer doors slide open. They look out at the inky blackness of space ... EXT. EDMUNDS’ DESERT PLANET - DUSK Brand looks at the setting sun ... MURPH (V.O.) By the light of our new sun ... INT. HANGAR, COOPER STATION - MORNING The Mechanic opening up, walks along the row of ships until- One is MISSING. EXT. EDMUNDS’ DESERT PLANET - DUSK Brand turns from the dwindling light ... MURPH (V.O.) In our new home. She heads down through the twilight towards camp. And we - Fade out. Credits. End.
